mostWorthwhile.text: Coring the band was most worthwhile: the intact layer and surrounding ice made the sample feel like a meaningful record of the exposure.

surprise.text: The drill captured a complete band between paler layers in a sealed liner; I had not expected that much of the surrounding ice to be described.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: drilling collected the sample and the buffered case supported its frozen return.

continue.text: Yes. I would choose to continue to learn what the receiving lab finds in the cores, though this chapter's decisions were straightforward.
